evidenceLayout: tmp/plv/<planId>/ holds each plan's full command logs; per-attempt reruns go under tmp/plv/<planId>/attempt-<n>/. Each log ends with an exit=<status> line. Each plan's Progress Log records every command, its exit status and its log path. tmp/ is gitignored and stays untracked. A missing or truncated log is not a pass.

executionModel.commitOwner: The orchestrator commits the accepted design and these plans before fanout, then commits the implementation after review. Each commit uses the AGENTS.md numbered 1-6 section message with no Co-Authored-By or tool attribution. Workers never commit, stash, checkout, reset, branch, push or merge.
executionModel.retryPolicy: Plans in one wave share the working directory. If cargo fails only inside another concurrent plan's files, or reports a lock, wait about 60 s and retry, up to 10 times. Then record a blocker in the plan's Progress Log and stop.
executionModel.editProtocol: Before each edit, re-read the file and record its sha256 and an intent snapshot. If the file drifted because of a change you did not make, re-read it and re-apply only your own change, and record the drift. After editing, record the post-edit sha256. Never edit outside writePaths.
executionModel.serialReconciliation: PLV-20 alone touches the registry tables, controls and the checker domain. PLV-31 alone touches templates.vact, the editor template lists and golden_digests.txt (the 24 Plaits graph lines only). PLV-40 alone touches the inventory, notices, parent plans, handoff, README, design status and the manifest label. Formatting is rustfmt on each plan's own files only. Any repair outside a plan's writePaths is recorded as a blocker and applied serially by the orchestrator review step, with file, cause, fix and pre/post sha256.

requiredOutcomes: A shared original-Rust voice layer (control clock, decay timing, decay envelope, vactrol envelope, level compression, LPG SVF with gain interpolation, post limiter, per-lane post stage) in src/dsp/ugen/voice_layer.rs, used by all 24 Plaits templates through the new mono kinds vactrol-gate and decay-mod.

Neutral controls lpg-mode (off|ping|level, default off), lpg-decay (0.5) and lpg-color (0.5), with editor metadata (label, default, choices) and a naming test that also covers vactrol-gate and decay-mod.
Per-position registration tuples (enveloped rule, out gain, aux gain) stored once in src/dsp/ported/manifest.rs, plus a voice_layer CoverageState per row, starting at Pending.

Layer-shaped voice lifetime: no implicit fade, and the voice ends when the gate is closed and every gate is done. The logic lives in src/dsp/voice/lifetime.rs, and Template::compile resets the gate count.

A local mise task compare-plaits-voice that compares against the pinned plaits/dsp/voice.cc and low_pass_gate.h; results recorded in the Plaits plans; voice_layer becomes SourceStage only if every threshold is met.

designDecisionsAndRationale: D1: lpg-mode defaults to off, which copies the input bit for bit, so the render digests hold.
D2: gates are appended after the aux '* amp' and become the new root, so kernel post-order indices and seeds are unchanged.
D3: a voice start is the rising edge; level is compress(velocity) times the gate; kernels keep their accent and sustain/continuous/clocked controls.
D4: registration tuples live once in manifest.rs, read by slot; position 7 is WhenClocked and position 15 is Never.
D5: a 0.25 ms voice-anchored control clock, with the SVF frequency scaled by 48000/sr, so output is partition-invariant and rate-consistent.
D6: layer-shaped voices skip the implicit fade and end when every gate is done; the logic lives in src/dsp/voice/lifetime.rs so voice.rs stays under 1000 lines.
D7: decay-mod is opt-in, not pre-wired, to preserve kernel seeds.
D8: voice.cc moves to source; the new files are inventoried and noticed.
D9: voice_layer becomes SourceStage only when the probe meets its thresholds (trajectory max-abs error <= 1e-4 and audio correlation >= 0.999 at 48 kHz); never SourcePort.
intentionalTradeoffs: off mode skips the upstream post gain, limiter and clip, which preserves existing levels and digests.

There is no upstream trigger delay. The probe aligns at the upstream detected rising-edge block, which is block 20 for a trigger raised at block 16: the delay-line Read(5) gives an effective 4-block delay. The 1.25 ms wording in the design is corrected in PLV-40's status note.
The 0.3/0.1 hysteresis is not applied (the event gate is boolean). The int16 scale, polarity inversion and Clip16 offset are omitted; ping and level clip at +-1.
The limiter resets per voice. Engine accent is unchanged in every mode. decay-mod models only the trigger-patched branch.
supportedEdgeCases: Already-enveloped positions (2, 3, 4, 19, 20, 21, 22, 23) bypass the LPG and apply only the post stage; position 7 counts as enveloped when clocked >= 0.5.
Negative registered gains run the limiter with pre-gain -G and post gain 1 (positions 15..20).
Main and aux lanes have independent gains and limiters.
In-place Template::compile recompile from a gated template to a gate-free template resets gates to 0 and keeps the implicit fade.
lpg-mode latched at the first control block; lpg-decay and lpg-color read at every block.
Partition invariance across block sizes 64, 256 and 97 at 44.1, 48 and 96 kHz; cut-group and steal fades still apply.
The pinned upstream checkout is absent: the probe and audit are recorded as BLOCKED and the label stays Pending.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: The upstream trigger-unpatched internal modulation offset (default_internal_modulation) in decay-mod.
Continuous CV level input (level is velocity times gate).
Speech prosody replay at position 15 and the chiptune source envelope at position 7.
Audible review (recorded as pending in the handoff).
